pattern_explanation: Turkish borrowed many academic and everyday words from French and other European languages, so several Turkish words look almost identical to English words. When the spelling matches but the meaning has shifted, learners can be misled, so these pairs need explicit attention.
false_friend_warning: Watch out for false friends: the Turkish word sempatik (transliteration) means likable or pleasant, not sympathetic, and aktüel means current or up to date, not actual. Likewise, eventüel means possible or if necessary rather than eventual, and kolej refers to a private high school rather than a college.
